notes.title: Game development status🔧
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, dear players![/b] 😊

🔶 Now we often receive questions about whether the game is finished, so we have decided to write a special post on this topic to dispel your doubts. At the moment «Sinful Soul» is [b]still in development[/b], we are collecting feedback from users and will take it into account when creating new chapters of the game. On April 8, only the first chapter of the novel was released, and we plan to continue releasing chapters with user feedback in mind.

We will be very glad to receive your comments and questions about «Sinful Soul»! 😍

notes.title: Meet the main character!
notes.notes:
Meet the protagonist of our new erotic novel, [b]Sinful Soul[/b]. He leads a mundane life, going through the motions of his routine day in and day out. He works a boring 9-to-5 job, lives alone in a small apartment, and has almost no friends. He feels like he's stuck in a rut, and he's desperate for a change.

One day, he hears about the Sinful Soul club, a secret club where members can explore their deepest desires and live out their wildest fantasies. Intrigued, he decides to check it out. When he arrives, he's greeted by a seductive girl who leads him inside the club.

As the main character takes in his surroundings, he feels a sense of excitement and anticipation building inside him. For the first time in a long time, he feels alive. As he delves deeper into the world of Sinful Soul, he begins to realize that he's not just exploring his sexual desires, but also his emotional ones.

The visual novel, [b]Sinful Soul[/b], is not just about erotic encounters; it's about a man's journey towards self-discovery and self-acceptance. Main character's story is relatable to many people who may feel stuck in a rut or are afraid to explore their deepest desires. Sinful Soul shows that it's okay to be curious, and it's okay to take risks. It reminds us that we all have a Sinful Soul deep inside, waiting to be unleashed.

notes.title: The first part of the game «Sinful Soul» game is released on Steam!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of the first part of our new game «Sinful Soul» on Steam! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you an immersive and exciting gaming experience that we're sure you'll love.

[list]
[*] Our game is a thrilling erotic novella in a cyberpunk world filled with danger and intrigue. You'll take on the role of an ordinary office worker who finally gets a chance to escape from the absorbing routine into the world of luxury and temptation. In our game, you will also meet three beautiful girls, each with a unique character and appearance.

[/list]We are waiting for you to play our game and leave your feedback ❤

 🔸 We also plan to release new chapters of the novel as the project develops further.

You can also join our Discord server where we will post all the latest news about the game: https://discord.gg/SAR6Cswj

notes.title: The «Sinful Soul» game is now available for Wishlisting on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i][h3]We are proud to announce that our game «Sinful Soul» is now available for Wishlisting on Steam!😌[/h3][/i]

🔸For months, our team has worked hard to create a game that would bring joy to players, and now it's almost ready for you to experience. We hope that our game will bring you a sense of adventure, excitement, passionate desire and more. 

🔸We understand that gaming can be an emotional and personal experience for many, and our game was designed with that in mind. We are excited to share this experience with you, and for you to join us on this journey. 

🔸Your support means the world to us and we want to thank you for being part of our story. We look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing how you interact with our game.

[i]Thank you for being a part of this journey with us, and we can't wait to share our game with you! [/i] ❤️
